items.name: Cloak of the Forest Gate
items.lore: Rowan-green, with the tree of Hibernia in grey thread. Given to those who opened the border.

items.name: Rowan-Ward Torc
items.lore: Rowan wood bound in bronze, cut from the gate's own ward. The Queen's people won't touch it.

items.name: Gate-Ranger's Ring
items.lore: A ranger's ring, worn smooth on a bowstring.

items.name: Borderer's Bracer
items.lore: Hard leather, scored by black wraiths' claws.

items.name: Dark Man's Cloak-Clasp
items.lore: A clasp of black iron from the Dark Man's cloak. It is always cold, and always a little heavier at night.

draughts: Whatever the Rangers keep in it, it works. Don't ask.
Bitter red berries in honey. It clears the head of glamours.
Drawn at night from Moon Lake. It tastes of silver.
For the first bad minute in the Cursed Forest. There will be one.
The herders' mead. Everything comes back a little faster after a cup.
